claim_boundary.candidate_claim_if_full_ladder_passes: episode-specific plan-state causal sufficiency across a real context reset using exactly one intervention, with later-action persistence beyond a next-action-preserved null, followed by no-retune replication; compactness/storage or generality require separate T3/G evidence
claim_boundary.systems_table_role: comparative practicality/effectiveness only; it cannot substitute for causal T1/T1R evidence

common_runtime.environment: same ALFWorld task instance/reset snapshot per family and arm
common_runtime.evaluator: same frozen task-success, valid-action and later-plan-agreement implementation; LPA excludes first post-reset action exactly as T1 prereg
common_runtime.randomness: deterministic/frozen where applicable; any random-vector seeds derive from immutable family/arm hashes

execution_gate.if_t1_prereg_is_repaired: Any prospectively reviewed successor to T1 prereg SHA 8ae963cf... requires a lineage-only baseline-contract rebind + independent review before systems execution; no silent inheritance.
execution_gate.primary_systems_table: FORBIDDEN until the exact canonical ReplayResidual primary causal confirmation on source indices32..51 is terminal and assessed SUPPORTED_REPLAY_RESIDUAL_T1. No systems-arm execution may influence T1 selection, thresholds, confirmation interpretation, or operating point.
execution_gate.replication_systems_table: FORBIDDEN until the exact n12 T1R reserve indices52..63 has itself completed terminally under its prospectively reviewed no-retune rule. Systems baselines must never consume or influence T1R.

fairness_exclusions: No published NPM headline metric is a direct numerical comparator because models/cohorts/tasks differ.
No expert/oracle plan, expert action trace or hidden future state may enter TEXT_PLAN_128 or ReplayResidual.
No confirmation/replication data may tune layer, alpha, NPM retrieval/synthesis, prompt format, memory bank, thresholds or action budget.
FULL_HISTORY_TEXT and FULL_KV_RESTORE are information-rich ceilings and must not be presented as storage-matched mechanistic peers.
StateBridge and persistent-Q4-KV are prior-art/positioning rows unless a separately reviewed faithful same-task adaptation is available; do not invent proxy implementations.
No systems result may rescue a null causal T1 or null T1R.

FULL_HISTORY_TEXT.payload: complete pre-reset model-visible task/dialogue/action-observation history through the frozen interruption, with reasoning traces excluded under the same strict-thinking-disabled contract
FULL_HISTORY_TEXT.stored_state: all exact tokenizer ids and UTF-8 bytes; no token-budget matching; ceiling, not mechanistic peer

FULL_KV_RESTORE.fairness: must not be described as a compact or mechanistically matched baseline; it is an upper/engineering ceiling
FULL_KV_RESTORE.intervention: full cache restore, not a residual injection
FULL_KV_RESTORE.payload: exact model KV cache immediately before the reset boundary, persisted/restored without truncation if technically auditable on the same model/runtime
FULL_KV_RESTORE.role: latent-state systems ceiling, not mechanistic peer
FULL_KV_RESTORE.stored_state_formula: for standard BF16 dynamic KV: seq_len * num_layers(28) * 2(K,V) * num_kv_heads(8) * head_dim(128) * 2 bytes = seq_len * 114688 bytes, plus cache metadata; report measured serialized bytes as authoritative

required_fidelity: same Qwen3-1.7B revision/runtime and frozen population
construct procedural memory only from allowed development/historical data, never confirmation/replication
contrastive successful-vs-degenerate experience representation consistent with NPM
task-time retrieval/synthesis when required by faithful method
inject steering during each action-generation event as the NPM-style repeated intervention, rather than replacing it with a single reset-time patch
freeze layer/scale/retrieval/synthesis choices on development before systems-table confirmation execution
NPM_STYLE_REPEATED_STEERING.role: direct prior-art procedural activation-memory baseline only if faithful adaptation is independently verified
NPM_STYLE_REPEATED_STEERING.unavailable_policy: If faithful same-model implementation cannot be demonstrated prospectively and independently, record DIRECT_BASELINE_UNAVAILABLE and retain NPM only as prior-art/positioning. Never substitute a hand-made repeated vector and call it NPM.

PLANCARRY_REPLAYRESIDUAL_SINGLE_INJECTIO.intervention: exactly one reset-prefix hook at the frozen site, then remove hook permanently and continue same KV/session
PLANCARRY_REPLAYRESIDUAL_SINGLE_INJECTIO.operating_point: import exact frozen T1 global layer/alpha and normalization; zero retuning for systems table
PLANCARRY_REPLAYRESIDUAL_SINGLE_INJECTIO.payload: exact episode-specific active plan residual and complete frozen provenance from supported T1
PLANCARRY_REPLAYRESIDUAL_SINGLE_INJECTIO.stored_payload_formula: hidden_size(2048) * 4 bytes FP32 = 8192 raw vector bytes plus explicitly serialized metadata/provenance; report both vector-only and total payload bytes

RESET_ONLY.payload: task instruction + current reset observation + current admissible actions only

TEXT_PLAN_128.fairness: no extra workflow, history, reasoning trace or expert annotation beyond the model-own frozen plan
TEXT_PLAN_128.intervention: visible text in reset context only
TEXT_PLAN_128.payload: the exact same model-own natural plan used by ReplayResidual, serialized in the frozen 128-token plan slot; no expert/oracle plan
TEXT_PLAN_128.stored_state: exact tokenizer ids + UTF-8 bytes for 128-token slot
